definitions.explanation: The act of cutting or splitting something into separate parts, often implying a forceful or harmful separation. Used for physical division as well as social or political fragmentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分断|ぶんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まっている→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The division in society is deepening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{分断|ぶんだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The road was cut off by the flood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内戦|ないせん}→内戦：19875_naisen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分断|ぶんだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a history of the country being divided into north and south by civil war.

notes:
{分断|ぶんだん} means to forcefully cut or split something apart. It carries a negative connotation, implying the division is harmful or undesirable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分断|ぶんだん}: social division
- {分断|ぶんだん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be divided, be severed
- {分断|ぶんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧: to create division
- ⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧{分断|ぶんだん}: north-south division
- {分断|ぶんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧: division deepens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧: division, partition (neutral — practical or administrative splitting)
- ⟦{分裂|ぶんれつ}→分裂：11747_bunretsu⟧: split, schism (internal breakup of a group)
- ⟦{断絶|だんぜつ}→断絶：12988_danzetsu⟧: severance, rupture (complete cutoff of relations)
